//go:build integration

package validators

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

func TestT101StudentCSSUsesActualProvider(t *testing.T) {
	address := os.Getenv("T101_NATS_URL")
	if address == "" {
		t.Skip("requires explicitly isolated actual CSS NATS provider")
	}
	conn, err := natsgo.Connect(address)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	client := NewFactory(conn, "", "", "styles.validate.request", "", "", "").GetValidator("CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET")
	proof := map[string]any{"boundary": "Student production Factory/CSS adapter → actual registered CSS NATS subscriber/DI/PostCSS/Sass", "full_live_e2e": false, "syntax_only_legacy_fallback": true}
	cases := []struct {
		name      string
		files     []WorkspaceFile
		valid     bool
		technical bool
	}{
		{"valid_css", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles.css", Content: ".card { color: red; }"}}, true, false},
		{"valid_scss", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles.scss", Content: "$color: red; .card { color: $color; }"}}, true, false},
		{"valid_acss", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles.acss", Content: ".card { color: red; }"}}, true, false},
		{"empty_existing_css", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "empty.css", Content: ""}}, true, false},
		{"malformed_css", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles.css", Content: ".card { color: red;"}}, false, true},
		{"malformed_scss", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "styles.scss", Content: ".card { color: $missing; }"}}, false, true},
		{"later_invalid_file", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "valid.css", Content: ".card { color: red; }"}, {Path: "broken.css", Content: ".bad {"}}, false, true},
		{"unsupported_sass_even_with_css", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "valid.css", Content: ".card { color: red; }"}, {Path: "styles.sass", Content: ".card\n  color: red"}}, false, true},
		{"no_stylesheets", []WorkspaceFile{{Path: "index.html", Content: "<div>Public fixture</div>"}}, false, false},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			result, err := client.ValidateAll(ctx, "t101-public-task", tc.files)
			item := map[string]any{"technical_error": err != nil, "valid": result != nil && result.Valid}
			if result != nil {
				codes := []string{}
				for _, issue := range result.Errors {
					codes = append(codes, issue.Code)
				}
				item["error_codes"] = codes
			}
			proof[tc.name] = item
			if tc.technical {
				if err == nil || result != nil {
					t.Fatalf("required technical error without successful result; result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || result == nil || result.Valid != tc.valid {
				t.Fatalf("expected valid=%t, result=%#v err=%v", tc.valid, result, err)
			}
			if !tc.valid && (len(result.Errors) == 0 || result.Errors[0].Code != "NO_CSS_FILE") {
				t.Fatalf("expected no-source negative, got %#v", result)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("no_actual_responder", func(t *testing.T) {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		missing := NewFactory(conn, "", "", "t101.isolated.no-responder", "", "", "").GetValidator("css")
		result, err := missing.ValidateAll(ctx, "t101-public-task", cases[0].files)
		proof["no_actual_responder"] = map[string]any{"technical_error": err != nil, "result_nil": result == nil}
		if err == nil || result != nil {
			t.Fatalf("unavailable provider produced result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
		}
	})
	proof["assertions_passed"] = !t.Failed()
	if path := os.Getenv("T101_RESULT_FILE"); path != "" {
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(proof, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
